name: Resurrection Signet
description: Signet. Resurrects target party member (100% Health, 25% Energy). This signet only recharges when you gain a morale boost.

name: Signet of Capture
description: Signet. Choose one skill from a nearby dead Boss of your profession. Signet of Capture is permanently replaced by that skill. If that skill was elite, gain 250 XP for every level you have earned.

name: Lightbringer Signet
description: Signet. You gain 4...5 strikes of adrenaline and 22...24 Energy if you are within the area of a demonic servant of Abaddon.

name: Lightbringer's Gaze
description: Skill. Target demonic servant of Abaddon takes 100 holy damage and is interrupted. Hits one additional foe in the area for each rank of Lightbringer you have attained. This skill is disabled (15 seconds).

name: Sunspear Rebirth Signet
description: Signet. Resurrect target dead ally at your location (full Health and 10% Energy for each Sunspear Rank attained). This signet only recharges when you gain a morale boost.

name: Air of Superiority
description: Skill. (20...30 seconds). Gain a random Asura benefit every time you earn experience from killing an enemy.

name: Asuran Scan
description: Hex Spell. (9...12 seconds.) You cannot miss target foe. If you kill this foe, you lose 5% Death Penalty.

name: Mental Block
description: Enchantment Spell. (5...11 seconds.) You have a 50% chance to block. Renewal: every time an enemy hits you.

name: Mindbender
description: Enchantment Spell. (10...16 seconds.) You move 20...33% faster and cast Spells 20% faster.

name: Pain Inverter
description: Hex Spell. (6...10 seconds.) Deals 100...140% of the damage (maximum 80) back to target foe every time it does damage.

name: Radiation Field
description: Ward Spell. (5 seconds.) Causes -4...6 Health degeneration to foes in the area. End effect: inflicts Disease condition (12...20 seconds) to foes in the area.

name: Smooth Criminal
description: Spell. (10...20 seconds.) Disables one Spell. This skill becomes that Spell. You gain 5...10 Energy.

name: Summon Ice Imp
description: Spell. Summon a level 14...20 Ice Imp (40...60 lifespan) that has Ice Spikes. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.

name: Summon Mursaat
description: Spell. Summon a level 14...20 Mursaat (40...60 lifespan) that has Enervating Charge. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.

name: Summon Naga Shaman
description: Spell. Summon a level 14...20 Naga Shaman (40...60 lifespan) that has Stoning. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.

name: Summon Ruby Djinn
description: Spell. Summon a level 14...20 Ruby Djinn (40...60 lifespan) that has Immolate. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.

name: Technobabble
description: Spell. Deals 30...40 damage to target and adjacent foes. Inflicts Dazed condition (3...5 seconds) on these foes if target was not a boss.

name: "By Ural's Hammer!"
description: Shout. (30 seconds.) Resurrect all dead party members in earshot with full Health and Energy. Affected party members deal 25...33% more damage. Affected party members die when it ends, but do not receive a death penalty.

name: "Don't Trip!"
description: Shout. (3...5 seconds.) Prevents knock-down; affects party members within earshot.

name: Alkar's Alchemical Acid
description: Spell. Projectile: deals 40...50 damage to target and adjacent foes. Deals 45...70 more damage and inflicts Cracked Armor condition (14...20 seconds) to Destroyers.

name: Black Powder Mine
description: Trap. (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Deals 20...30 damage. Inflicts Blindness and Bleeding conditions (7...10 seconds). Easily interrupted.

name: Brawling Headbutt
description: Touch Skill. Deals 45...70 damage; causes knock-down.

name: Breath of the Great Dwarf
description: Spell. Removes burning and heals for 50...60 Health. Affects party members.

name: Drunken Master
description: Stance. (72...90 seconds.) You move and attack 10...15% faster if you are not drunk. You move and attack 25...33% faster if you are drunk.

name: Dwarven Stability
description: Enchantment Spell. (24...30 seconds.) Your stances last 55...100% longer. You cannot be knocked-down if you activated this skill while drunk.

name: Ear Bite
description: Touch Skill. Deals 50...70 piercing damage and inflicts Bleeding condition (15...25 seconds).

name: Great Dwarf Armor
description: Enchantment Spell. (22...40 seconds.) +24 armor and +60 maximum Health. Additional +24 armor against Destroyers.

name: Great Dwarf Weapon
description: Weapon Spell. (20 seconds.) +15...20 weapon damage and 28...40% chance to cause knock-down with attacks. Cannot self-target.

name: Light of Deldrimor
description: Spell. Deals 55...80 holy damage to foes in the area. Pings hidden objects within the area on the compass.

name: Low Blow
description: Touch Skill. Deals 45...70 damage. Inflicts 30...50 damage and Cracked Armor (14...20 seconds) if target foe is knocked down.

name: Snow Storm
description: Spell. Deals 30...40 cold damage each second (5 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target foe's initial location.

name: Deft Strike
description: Ranged Attack. Deals 18...30 damage. Inflicts Bleeding condition (18...30 seconds) if target foe has Cracked Armor.

name: Ebon Battle Standard of Courage
description: Ward Spell. (14...20 seconds.) Allies in this ward have +24 armor and +24 more armor against Charr. Spirits are unaffected.

name: Ebon Battle Standard of Honor
description: Ward Spell. (14...20 seconds.) Allies in this ward deal +8...15 damage and +7...10 more damage against Charr. Spirits are unaffected.

name: Ebon Battle Standard of Wisdom
description: Ward Spell. (14...20 seconds.) Spells that allies in this ward cast have a 44...60% chance to recharge 50% faster. Spirits are unaffected.

name: Ebon Escape
description: Spell. Heals you and target ally for 70...110. Initial effect: Shadow Step to this ally. Cannot self-target.

name: Ebon Vanguard Assassin Support
description: Spell. Summon a level 14...20 assassin that has Iron Palm, Fox Fangs, and Nine Tail Strike; it Shadow Steps to this foe. If this foe is a Charr, the assassin lives for 24...30 seconds. If target foe is not a Charr, the Assassin lives for 12...15 seconds.

name: Ebon Vanguard Sniper Support
description: Spell. Deals 54...90 piercing damage and inflicts Bleeding condition (5...25 seconds). 10% chance of +540...900 piercing damage. 25% chance of +540...900 piercing damage if target foe is a Charr.

name: Signet of Infection
description: Signet. Inflicts Diseased condition 13...20 seconds if target foe is Bleeding.

name: Sneak Attack
description: Melee Attack. Inflicts Blindness (5...8 seconds). Counts as a lead attack.

name: Tryptophan Signet
description: Signet. (14...20 seconds.) Target and adjacent foes move and attack 23...40% slower.

name: Weakness Trap
description: Trap. (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Deals 24...50 lightning damage. Inflicts Weakness condition (10...20 seconds). Knocks-down Charr. Easily interrupted.

name: Winds
description: Ebon Vanguard Ritual. Creates a level 4...10 spirit (54...90 second lifespan.) Affects foes within range. 15% chance to miss with ranged attacks.

name: "Dodge This!"
description: Shout. (16...20 seconds.) Your next attack is unblockable and deals +14...20 damage.

name: "Finish Him!"
description: Shout. Deals 44...80 damage and inflicts Cracked Armor and Deep Wound conditions (12...20 seconds). No effect unless target foe has less than 50% Health.

name: "I Am Unstoppable!"
description: Shout. (16...20 seconds.) You have +24 armor and cannot be knocked-down or Crippled.

name: "I Am the Strongest!"
description: Shout. Your next 5...8 attacks deal +14...20 damage.

name: "You Are All Weaklings!"
description: Shout. Inflicts Weakness condition (8...12 seconds). Also affects adjacent foes.

name: "You Move Like a Dwarf!"
description: Shout. Deals 44...80 damage, causes knock-down, and inflicts Crippled condition (8...15 seconds).

name: A Touch of Guile
description: Touch Hex Spell. Deals 44...80 damage. Target foe cannot attack (5...7...8 seconds) if it was knocked-down.

name: Club of a Thousand Bears
description: Melee Attack. Deals +6...9 damage for each adjacent foe (maximum 60 damage). Causes knock-down if target foe is non-human.

name: Feel No Pain
description: Skill. (30 seconds.) You have +2...3 Health regeneration. You have +200...300 maximum Health if you are drunk when activating this skill.

name: Raven Blessing
description: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the Raven (60 seconds). All your attributes are set to 0 and raven attacks replace your skills, and you have 80 armor, 660...700 Health, and a 20...30% block chance.

name: Ursan Blessing
description: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the bear (60 seconds). All your attributes are set to 0 and bear attacks replace your skills, and you have 100 armor and 750...790...800 Health.

name: Volfen Blessing
description: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the wolf (60 seconds). All your attributes are set to 0 and wolf attacks replace your skills, and you have 80 armor, 660...700 Health and 2...4 Health regeneration.
